arms.compiled:
Compiled arm: only decisions that reference this payout's seller_id or one of its SKUs, plus the
    global rules (the refund-approval rule applies to every payout). Selected by reference, never by the answer.
arms.raw: Raw arm: every decision in the ledger, for every payout.

expectation: compiled > raw (Phase 1: raw-style context, no reasoning, 4/30)
nodes: known-good node list per market from measured outcomes (relay_nosana/nosana/nodes.py), open market as fallback; in-container deadline 20 min
routing: compiled arm if its CI lower bound >= 0.90, else human review for payouts > $500
scoring: exact match of {decision, reason_code} against data.truth(); per arm over all 60 payouts, Wilson 95% CI; also the > $500 subset; paired discordant counts with an exact two-sided binomial (sign) test
why_60: Wilson 95% lower bound for 30/30 is 0.886 < 0.90; at n = 60, 59/60 gives 0.911
